status: Closed — receipt-backed runner publication close path re-verified 2026-09-02
finding: Required runner-sync release mirror outputs are generated after framework source delivery but are excluded from the taskflow close bundle as out-of-scope advisory dirty files, leaving a second manual governance decision before push.
expectedBehavior: When runner-sync is required by a framework task, ATM should provide a governed follow-up lane or commit bundle for release artifacts and runner-sync receipts instead of leaving them as ambiguous dirty residue.
evidenceOrRepro: Historical reproduction: ATM-GOV-0186 close dry-run/write reported release/atm-onefile and release/atm-root-drop as excluded dirty files after a required runner-sync build. Current source re-verification on 2026-09-02: taskflow close registers the runner-sync queue when publication is required, resolves a receipt through `resolveRunnerPublicationCloseHandoff`, and includes its receipt-authorized publication files in the commit bundle. `runner-publication-bundle-authority`, `runner-sync-clean-close-pathway`, `runner-sync-post-close-receipt-publication`, and `taskflow-stale-runner-lane` passed; each rejects a missing or non-authoritative receipt rather than widening the bundle.
followUp: Closed. Maintain receipt-authority and stale-runner close regressions; reopen only for a new path that again leaves a required publication output as ambiguous residue.
